po: Bachelor Chemie und Mathematik für Nachhaltigkeit (2024)

categories.name: Sustainability studies: basic modules
categories.note: Basic modules 'Grundlagen und Theorien der Nachhaltigkeit' (6 ECTS) and 'Erkenntnistheorie und Methoden der Nachhaltigkeit' (6 ECTS) are both required

summary: Only the general regulations for Integrated Sustainability Studies (AB NaS, section 8) are published on the program page; they require both sustainability basic modules plus sustainability specializations (and in variant A a 12-ECTS sustainability project). The program's own examination regulations (chemistry and mathematics parts) were not found, so no further rules are encoded.
